name: paper-finder-student-mcp
description: Academic paper search MCP server. Search scholarly papers, find open access copies and related work through OpenAlex (https://openalex.org), with no key needed.

tools.name: search_papers
tools.description: Search scholarly papers by keywords. Returns title, authors, year, venue, citation count, DOI and a free to read link when one exists. Inputs: query (required keywords), from_year (optional earliest publication year), open_access_only (optional, false by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'find open access papers on spaced repetition since 2020.'

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description: Details for one paper, including the abstract and a free to read link when one exists. A wrong or unknown reference returns a not found error that suggests searching by title or checking the DOI format. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807). Example prompt: 'show me the abstract of DOI 10.1038/nature14539.'

tools.name: get_paper_by_doi
tools.description: Details for one paper looked up by DOI only, including the abstract and a free to read link when one exists. An OpenAlex id or a malformed DOI returns an invalid ref error that points at get_paper. Inputs: doi (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539 or a doi.org link). Example prompt: 'get the paper with DOI 10.1038/nature14539.'

tools.name: find_open_access_pdf
tools.description: Finds a free to read copy of one paper and returns the link, preferring a PDF over a landing page. When OpenAlex has no free copy it says so in plain words instead of failing. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807). Example prompt: 'find a free PDF of this paper, DOI 10.1038/nature14539.'

tools.name: related_papers
tools.description: Papers that OpenAlex lists as related to a given paper. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'what papers are related to DOI 10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762?'

tools.name: get_related_work
tools.description: Other papers on the same topic as one paper. Returns the same list as related_papers, kept as a verb-first name for clients that prefer it. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'what related work should I read for DOI 10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762?'

tools.name: cited_by
tools.description: Newer papers that cite a given paper, most recent first. Inputs: paper (required, a DOI like 10.1038/nature14539, a doi.org link, or an OpenAlex id like W2741809807), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'who cited DOI 10.48550/arXiv.1706.03762?'

tools.name: list_author_papers
tools.description: Papers by one author, most cited first. Matches the author name as it is written on the papers, so exact spelling matters. Inputs: author (required, the name as it appears on the paper, for example Jane Doe), from_year (optional earliest publication year), open_access_only (optional, false by default), limit (optional, 1 to 25, default 8). Example prompt: 'list papers by John Dewey on education since 1950.'
